build_system: Flutter SDK ^3.11.0, standard flutter build. No custom build scripts.
test_framework: flutter_test (dev dependency). No widget or unit test files exist for news_screen or kap_news_service yet.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `flutter analyze` — must exit 0 with no errors. 2. Run `flutter build apk --debug` — must complete successfully. No automated widget tests exist; manual verification on device: disconnect network, reopen app, confirm KAP tab shows cached items with offline badge.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lib/models/portfolio_model.g.dart is generated by hive_generator — do NOT modify it. No other generated files for files being changed.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine. All paths must use backslashes or the worktree absolute path d:\k\wink\teknik_bakis. Do not run flutter on a simulator — only build/analyze for verification.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md found. Match existing code style: static classes, no provider/bloc/cubit for this feature (screen manages its own state with setState), shared_preferences already in pubspec.yaml at ^2.3.5.
key_patterns: - KapDisclosureService uses in-memory cache (_CachedDisclosures map) inside the class itself — persistent cache fits the same pattern as a new static layer on top. - KapNewsService.fetch() and KapDisclosureService.fetchLatest() are both static methods called directly from _NewsScreenState._loadKap(). - KapNewsItem has no toJson/fromJson — must be added. - Deduplication is done via KapNewsService.dedupe() AFTER fetch; cache must store post-dedupe items. - The '_fallback()' method in KapNewsService returns 5 hardcoded items — offline cache must NOT trigger fallback; it is a separate path before fallback. - shared_preferences is already in pubspec.yaml (^2.3.5), no new package needed.
directory_structure: lib/models/ — data models; lib/services/ — fetch/cache services (all static); lib/screens/ — UI screens managing their own state with StatefulWidget+setState; lib/kap_ai/ — KAP AI engine (do not touch); lib/widgets/ — shared widgets.
